basic_details.job_title: NII Research Associate II Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online

application_fee.details: The notification does not mention any application fee.

qualification.details: Preference will be given to candidates who have hands-on experience in at least one of the following areas: molecular biology, cell biology (bacterial and mammalian cell culture), protein biochemistry, crystallography, and animal handling.

salary_details.research associate-ii: Rs. 61,000/- per month plus 27% HRA (As per DST OM dated 26.06.2023)
salary_details.details: The emoluments are consolidated as per the specified Office Memorandum and do not include additional allowances beyond the stated HRA.

selection_process: The selection process consists of shortlisting followed by a walk-in interview conducted through online mode.
Only shortlisted candidates will be communicated through email with the date and online link for the interview after the last date of applications. Only registered candidates will be interviewed.
how_to_apply: Download the prescribed application format provided in the official notification PDF.
Fill up the application form carefully with all required details.
Ensure the date of passing examinations is indicated clearly.
Attach necessary documents for verification along with the filled application form and CV.
Send the completed application through online mode to the Project Investigator's email ID at [email protected] on or before 14 October 2026.
important_instructions: Applications will be accepted only through online mode. Applications containing incomplete information without CVs shall not be entertained. Date of passing the examinations must be indicated clearly in the application form. Only registered candidates will be interviewed. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: NII Research Associate-II Vacancy Details (Post-wise)
content_sections.text: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Research Associate-II position.

content_sections.heading: NII Research Associate-II Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Preference will be given to candidates who have hands-on experience in at least one of the following areas: molecular biology, cell biology (bacterial and mammalian cell culture), protein biochemistry, crystallography, and animal handling.

rows.qualification_required: PhD in Biological or Chemical Sciences, with one year of research experience with a good academic record. The candidate should have demonstrated aptitude through publications in peer reviewed journals.

content_sections.heading: NII Research Associate-II Salary
content_sections.text: The emoluments are consolidated as per the specified Office Memorandum and do not include additional allowances beyond the stated HRA.

rows.pay_level_pay: Rs. 61,000/- per month plus 27% HRA (As per DST OM dated 26.06.2023)

content_sections.heading: NII Research Associate-II Application Fee
content_sections.text: The notification does not mention any application fee.

content_sections.heading: NII Research Associate-II Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of shortlisting followed by a walk-in interview conducted through online mode. Only shortlisted candidates will be communicated through email with the date and online link for the interview after the last date of applications. Only registered candidates will be interviewed.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NII Research Associate-II
content_sections.text: Download the prescribed application format provided in the official notification PDF. Fill up the application form carefully with all required details. Ensure the date of passing examinations is indicated clearly. Attach necessary documents for verification along with the filled application form and CV. Send the completed application through online mode to the Project Investigator's email ID at [email protected] on or before 14 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Prescribed application form Necessary educational and experience documents for verification Curriculum Vitae (CV)

content_sections.heading: NII Research Associate-II Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications will be accepted only through online mode. Applications containing incomplete information without CVs shall not be entertained. Date of passing the examinations must be indicated clearly in the application form. Only registered candidates will be interviewed. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment position advertised by NII?
faq.answer: NII has advertised for the Research Associate-II position under the Integrative Structural Biology Laboratory (ISBL).

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in NII Research Associate-II Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is only 1 vacancy available for the Research Associate-II position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for the NII Research Associate-II position?
faq.answer: The last date for applying to the said position is 14 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for NII Research Associate-II?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a PhD in Biological or Chemical Sciences with one year of research experience, a good academic record, and demonstrated aptitude through publications in peer-reviewed journals.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for NII Research Associate-II?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is not specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for NII Research Associate-II?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for NII Research Associate-II Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must fill out the application form in the prescribed format and submit it along with necessary documents and CV through online mode to the Project Investigator's email ID ([email protected]).

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for NII Research Associate-II?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive Rs. 61,000/- per month plus 27% HRA as per DST OM dated 26.06.2023.

faq.question: Q9. When will the interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted through online mode on 15 October 2026 (Thursday), for shortlisted candidates only.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, this is a project-based temporary position for a duration of six months (6 months) funded by DBT.
